decisive_items: frequent respiratory episodes during first year of life
response.rationale: The patient has a confirmed CFTR mutation (F508del/3849+10kbC-T), which is diagnostic for cystic fibrosis. The clinical features (pseudo-Bartter syndrome, recurrent respiratory infections, Pseudomonas colonization) are all secondary to CF. The other candidates are complications or manifestations of CF, not the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Chronic Pseudomonas infection is a consequence of CF, not the underlying diagnosis.
Pseudo-Bartter syndrome is a known complication of CF, not the primary disease.
